name: GDP (current US$)
sourceNote: GDP at purchaser's prices is the sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes and minus any subsidies not included in the value of the products.
sourceOrganization: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

name: GDP growth (annual %)
sourceNote: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.
sourceOrganization: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.
